headline: Key Functions and Classes in utils.py
what_breaks: fastapi/applications.py — relies on OpenAPI and routing
fastapi/dependencies/models.py — uses Dependant and related functions
fastapi/utils.py — utilizes utility functions for operations
why: This file contains critical functions and data structures for OpenAPI dependency handling, which are essential for routing and request validation. Changes here can affect how dependencies are resolved and how OpenAPI schemas are generated across the application.
checklist: Review changes to _get_openapi_dependency_data function for impact on dependencies.
Check modifications to _OpenAPIDependencyData dataclass for data integrity.
Ensure any updates to validation_error_definition and validation_error_response_definition align with OpenAPI standards.
Verify interactions with imported modules, especially fastapi.dependencies.models.
